title: DJ the Mansion with Roses x We Don’t Crash, We Ride - We Fly We Rose (Mashup)
style: bass house, 126 BPM, four on the floor, swung 16th hats, rolling synth bass, punchy clap, muted piano stabs, organ chords, filtered chord lifts, sub drop, sidechain pumping, short room reverb, DJ breakdown, call and response synth, sparse intro, peak-time release, late-night grit, controlled euphoria
lyrics:
[Intro]
Front gate open, midnight code  
Soft blue smoke on the access road  
Build online, heartbeat loud  
Channel live and above the crowd  

[Verse]
I sent that beat instead of a text  
You sent a siren right back, obsessed  
No small talk, just kick and snare  
You say more than words in the air  

Every old ghost shut outside  
When the kick goes in, we unify  
If the dog ate homework, never mind  
Spin that signal and we’ll be fine  

[Hook – A x B]
Come DJ the mansion with me  
Bring your strange little frequency  
Rose on the decks, Zyn on the screen  
Turn this whole broken place pristine  

We don’t crash, we ride  
Rose on the left, Zyn on the right  
Whole damn mansion neon-lit tonight  
We don’t crash, we ride  

[Build]
Come DJ the mansion with me  
Soft blue smoke on the access road  
Channel live and above the crowd  
When the kick goes in, we unify  

Rose on the decks, Zyn on the screen  
Three-three-six on every side  

[Drop – Chant Blend]
Ride, ride, ride  
Signal locked, no need to hide  
Ride, ride, ride  
Three-three-six on every side  

We don’t crash, we ride  
Come DJ the mansion with me  
Bring your strange little frequency  

[Final Hook / Outro]
We don’t crash, we ride  
Rose on the left, Zyn on the right  
Rose, come spin it  
Zyn, stay in it  
Mansion safe and fully lit  
Turn this whole broken place pristine  
We don’t crash, we ride
